record.edic_text:
5556 chrusoprasos {khroo-sop'-ras-os}

from 5557 and prason (a leek);; n m

AV - chrysoprasus 1; 1

1) chrysoprasus is a stone of green colour, inclined to that of
   gold, from whence it has its name; for this is agate in the
   breast plate, which was Naphtali's stone. (Gill)

same.cexp: 黃金；金幣，金錢；金飾，（貴重的）珠寶
橄欖石，黃璧璽（最貴重的一種）（#啟 21:20|）
用黃金遮蓋或裝飾，戴滿了金飾
